name: lock_server_sync-s60-r1
cmd: set -e; mkdir -p base; tar -xf replay-input/main.tar -C base; set -e; root=$PWD; base=$(cd 'base' && pwd); bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; (cd "$base" && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1); set +e; failed=0; for side in cand base; do dir=$root; [ "$side" = base ] && dir=$base; echo "PAIR begin side=$side id=lock_server_sync run=1"; (cd "$dir" && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only 'lock_server_sync' --skip 'broken,given') > /tmp/pair-$side.out 2>/tmp/pair-$side.err; s=$?; cat /tmp/pair-$side.out; grep -E 'small instance|join (enumerated|end|failed|exists|set|cone|td|houdini|engine|ic3|undecided|pool|filter)' /tmp/pair-$side.err | cut -c1-300 | tail -c 60000; tail -c 2000 /tmp/pair-$side.err | grep -iE 'error|throw' | tail -5; echo "PAIR end side=$side exit=$s"; if [ $s -ne 0 ] && [ $s -ne 124 ] && [ $s -ne 137 ]; then failed=1; fi; done; exit $failed
